notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapped to person_source_value to retain the original identifier.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as an Observation with a custom concept for the weight type; value_as_number holds the numeric weight.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored similarly to WTDRD1 as a numeric Observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/reliability. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using a custom concept for the status categories.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as an Observation with value_as_string; could also be linked to provider table if a provider concept is created.
Breast-fed infant indicator (binary). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using a custom Yes/No concept or standard concept 4188539 (Yes) / 4188540 (No).
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as value_as_number in an Observation.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric value. Stored as value_as_number.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for days of the week or standard concepts if available.
Language used mostly is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard language concepts (e.g., 4182343 for English, 4180190 for Spanish).
Main respondent indicator is categorical (e.g., self, proxy). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for respondent type.
Helped in responding indicator is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for helper involvement.
Type of table salt used is categorical (e.g., regular, sea salt, none). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for salt types.
How often add salt to food at table is ordinal (e.g., rarely, sometimes, always). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for frequency.
Salt used in preparation is ordinal (e.g., never, rarely, sometimes, always). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for frequency.
Categorical yes/no for being on a special diet. Can be stored as an Observation with a custom concept for 'On special diet'.
Weight loss/Low calorie diet type. No standard OMOP concept; use observation with custom concept or map to SNOMED diet concept if available.
Low fat/Low cholesterol diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Low salt/Low sodium diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Sugar free/Low sugar diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Low fiber diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
High fiber diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Diabetic diet. SNOMED concept_id 4134854 'Diabetic diet'.
Weight gain/Muscle building diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Low carbohydrate diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
High protein diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Gluten-free/Celiac diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Renal/Kidney diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Other special diet type. No direct standard concept; store as observation.
Number of foods reported is a continuous numeric value. Store as observation with numeric value.
Energy intake in kcal. Maps to OMOP Measurement with concept for 'Energy' (kcal).
Protein intake in grams. Maps to 'Protein intake' measurement concept.
Carbohydrate intake in grams. Maps to 'Carbohydrate intake' measurement concept.
Total sugars intake in grams. No specific standard concept for total sugars; mapped to 'Carbohydrate intake' as a component. Alternatively, could use 0 and specify in measurement_source_concept_id.
Dietary fiber intake in grams. No specific standard concept; mapped to 'Carbohydrate intake' as a subtype. Use measurement_source_concept_id for detail.
Total fat intake in grams. Maps to 'Total fat intake' measurement concept.
Saturated fat intake in grams. No specific standard concept; mapped to 'Total fat intake' as a subtype. Use measurement_source_concept_id.
Monounsaturated fat intake in grams. No specific standard concept; mapped to 'Total fat intake' as a subtype.
Polyunsaturated fat intake in grams. No specific standard concept; mapped to 'Total fat intake' as a subtype.
Cholesterol intake in mg. Maps to 'Cholesterol intake' measurement concept.
Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) intake in mg. Maps to 'Vitamin E intake' measurement concept.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) intake in mg. No specific concept for added form; mapped to 'Vitamin E intake'.
Retinol intake in mcg. No specific standard concept for retinol; mapped to 'Vitamin A intake' (retinol is a form of vitamin A).
Vitamin A, RAE (Retinol Activity Equivalents) in mcg. Maps to 'Vitamin A intake' measurement concept.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. No specific standard concept; mapped to 'Vitamin A intake' as a provitamin A carotenoid.
Beta-carotene intake from first day dietary recall. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake. No standard OMOP concept for this specific carotenoid intake; may use a generic carotenoid concept or custom mapping.
Lycopene intake from dietary recall. Maps to measurement of lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake. No single standard concept for combined lutein and zeaxanthin; may require two separate measurements or custom concept.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake from dietary recall. Maps to measurement of thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake. Maps to measurement of riboflavin.
Niacin intake. Maps to measurement of niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake. Maps to measurement of vitamin B6.
Total folate intake. Maps to measurement of folate.
Folic acid intake. No separate standard concept for folic acid as distinct from total folate; may use folate concept with modifier or custom concept.
Food folate intake. No standard concept for naturally occurring food folate separate from total folate; may use folate concept with 'food source' qualifier.
Folate, dietary folate equivalents (DFE). No standard OMOP concept for DFE; may map to folate with unit conversion or custom concept.
Total choline intake. No standard OMOP concept for choline intake; may require custom mapping.
Vitamin B12 intake. Maps to measurement of vitamin B12.
Added vitamin B12 intake. No standard concept for 'added' vs total B12; may use vitamin B12 concept with 'supplemental' qualifier or custom concept.
Vitamin C intake in mg; maps to measurement of ascorbic acid (LOINC 5540-6).
Vitamin D (D2+D3) intake in mcg; maps to measurement of vitamin D (LOINC 62292-7).
Vitamin K intake in mcg; maps to measurement of vitamin K (LOINC 5594-3).
Calcium intake in mg; maps to measurement of calcium (LOINC 17861-6).
Phosphorus intake in mg; maps to measurement of phosphorus (LOINC 14879-1).
Magnesium intake in mg; maps to measurement of magnesium (LOINC 2598-8).
Iron intake in mg; maps to measurement of iron (LOINC 2498-1).
Zinc intake in mg; maps to measurement of zinc (LOINC 5763-3).
Copper intake in mg; maps to measurement of copper (LOINC 5630-5).
Sodium intake in mg; maps to measurement of sodium (LOINC 2947-7).
Potassium intake in mg; maps to measurement of potassium (LOINC 2823-0).
Selenium intake in mcg; maps to measurement of selenium (LOINC 5693-3).
Caffeine intake in mg; maps to measurement of caffeine (LOINC 33255-7).
Theobromine intake in mg; no standard OMOP concept for theobromine measurement; use value_as_number with a local concept.
Alcohol intake in gm; maps to measurement of alcohol intake (LOINC 74027-7).
Moisture content in grams. Maps to measurement table as a numeric value. No standard concept_id for 'Moisture' as a nutrient; would require a custom measurement concept.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 (Butanoic) intake in grams. Maps to measurement table. No standard OMOP concept for individual fatty acid intake; would need a custom concept or use nutrient hierarchy.

Monounsaturated fatty acid 16:1 (Hexadecenoic) intake in grams. Maps to measurement table. No standard concept_id available.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 18:1 (Octadecenoic) intake in grams. Maps to measurement table. No standard concept_id available.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 20:1 (Eicosenoic) intake in grams. Maps to measurement table. No standard concept_id available.

Nutrient intake amount for PFA 18:4. Map to measurement table with appropriate nutrient concept_id for octadecatetraenoic acid.
Nutrient intake amount for PFA 20:4 (arachidonic acid). Map to measurement table with appropriate nutrient concept_id.
Nutrient intake amount for PFA 20:5 (eicosapentaenoic acid). Map to measurement table with appropriate nutrient concept_id.
Nutrient intake amount for PFA 22:5 (docosapentaenoic acid). Map to measurement table with appropriate nutrient concept_id.
Nutrient intake amount for PFA 22:6 (docosahexaenoic acid). Map to measurement table with appropriate nutrient concept_id.
Ordinal comparison of food consumed yesterday to usual. Map to observation table with a concept representing 'usual food intake comparison'.
Total plain water intake in grams. Map to measurement table with concept for plain water intake.
Total tap water intake in grams. Map to measurement table with concept for tap water intake.
Total bottled water intake in grams. Map to measurement table with concept for bottled water intake.
Categorical tap water source. Map to observation table with concept for water source type.
Binary indicator of shellfish consumption in past 30 days. Map to observation table with concept for shellfish intake status.
Binary indicator of clams consumption in past 30 days. Map to observation table with concept for clam intake status.

Binary indicator for crayfish consumption in past 30 days. Map to observation table with a custom concept for crayfish intake; value_as_concept_id can hold Yes/No concept (e.g., 4188539 'Yes', 4188540 'No').
Ordinal frequency of crayfish consumption. Store number of times as value_as_number; unit concept could be times/month. No standard concept for frequency of specific food.
Binary indicator for lobster consumption. Use observation table with Yes/No concepts.

This is a refusal flag for a dietary recall question about fish consumption. It indicates the participant refused to answer, not a clinical measurement. Map to OBSERVATION with a custom concept for 'Refused' (e.g., concept_id 0 or a locally defined concept). The observation_concept_id would represent the question itself.
